signatureAbility.signatureDescription: Some players thrive on making defenders look silly. When they enter the zone, this ability increases their fakeout rate on the next juke, spin or hurdle.
When lined up in the backfield, players with this ability have access to four additional hot routes, better route running, and improved catching against linebackers and linemen.
Ballcarriers with this ability have steerable juke and spin animations.
Ballcarriers with this ability can quickly shift momentum, change direction, and turn the corner without sacrificing speed.
Receivers with this ability will immediately and precisely react to a user's playmaker inputs.
Receivers with this ability make sharper cuts and frequently win contested catches when covered by linebackers and linemen.
When lined up as a receiver; players with this ability have access to four additional hot routes during pre-play adjustments; and react more promptly to playmaker inputs.
Ballcarriers with this ability have steerable spin animations.
Blockers with this ability reduce a rusher's chances of using a quick block shed move.
Players with this ability can detect user-controlled defenders before the snap; as well as 3rd and 4th down blitzers. Can be bluffed.
Blockers with this ability will allow less frequent shed attempts by their block target
Blockers with this ability reduce a rusher's chances of using a quick block shed move while run blocking.
Blockers with this ability reduce a rusher's chances of using a quick block shed move while pass blocking.
Blockers with this ability will frequently attempt and win impact blocks against linebackers and defensive backs when playing as a lineman or fullback.
